programs_aiCamp_contest_intro: Our curriculum is aligned with the AI Entrepreneurship Contest (AIEC), giving students the opportunity to compete in a recognized competition and present their innovations to industry judges.
programs_aiCamp_contest_modules_0: Rules interpretation and problem statement refinement
programs_aiCamp_contest_modules_1: Business plan and technical documentation coaching
programs_aiCamp_contest_optional: An optional 12-hour competition preparation module is available:
programs_aiCamp_cta_subtitle: Reserve your place in the next cohort and start building with AI.
programs_aiCamp_faq_items_onlyCoders_ans: No. This is an entrepreneurship and product development program. Teams are cross-functional, with roles in design, business, and communication alongside technical work. Technical depth is supported but is not required to participate or succeed.
programs_aiCamp_faq_items_services_answe: Ithaca offers academic tracks (AP, IB, OSSD, SAT/ACT, university coursework support, and tutoring) and project-based programs: the EV Team, the AI Entrepreneurship Bootcamp, the AI Investment Lab, Ithaca Dialogue, Engineering Foundations, Project Studio, and the Research Lab.
programs_aiCamp_faq_items_takeaway_answe: Each student completes the program with a six-part package: an innovation project, an MVP demonstration video with a market validation brief, a pitch deck and pitch video, a growth report, social media coverage, and access to the alumni community. Outstanding students may also be eligible for mentor recommendation letters.
programs_aiCamp_faq_items_whatIsIthaca_a: Ithaca Family Academy is an education organization that empowers young people to explore the future and build the skills to thrive in the AI era. Students learn through real-world projects by building, testing, collaborating, and presenting.
programs_aiCamp_faq_items_when_answer: The program runs {window}. Session times are {sessions}. Pitch Day is scheduled for {pitchDay}.
programs_aiCamp_faq_items_whoCanParticip: Ithaca serves students from middle school through university, and each program page lists its own grade range. We group participants by age and experience to provide the most suitable learning environment for each student.
Who can participate in Ithaca programs?
programs_aiCamp_goals_footer: Through this dual track of coursework and competition, students progress from idea to product and from pitch to contest.
programs_aiCamp_goals_items_competitive_: Students develop practical entrepreneurship skills by working through a rigorous innovation process, from problem discovery and customer validation to an investor-ready pitch.
programs_aiCamp_goals_items_exposure_des: Through hands-on workshops, mentor sessions, and competition preparation, students gain first-hand exposure to the intersection of technology and business innovation.
programs_aiCamp_goals_items_mentors_desc: Students connect with professionals from engineering, AI, and finance. Outstanding participants may be eligible for mentor recommendation letters for university applications.
programs_aiCamp_goals_items_mentors_titl: Access to an experienced mentor community
programs_aiCamp_goals_items_portfolio_de: Each team delivers a complete project package: an innovation prototype, an MVP demonstration video, a market validation brief, a pitch deck, a growth report, and social media coverage materials.
programs_aiCamp_hero_subtitle: From first idea to investor-ready pitch in 13 weeks. For students in Grades 9 through 12.
programs_aiCamp_meta_description: A 13-week program in which students build AI-powered startup projects, develop minimum viable products (MVPs), and pitch to investors.
programs_aiCamp_meta_title: AI Entrepreneurship Bootcamp | Ithaca Family Academy
programs_aiCamp_overview_p1: As AI transforms every industry, computational thinking and entrepreneurial skills have become essential for the next generation. The Ithaca AI Entrepreneurship Bootcamp gives students hands-on experience in applied AI, business innovation, and project incubation.
programs_aiCamp_overview_p2: Our inaugural cohort ran from September to November 2025 in collaboration with the University of Waterloo AI Team. The second cohort ran from January to June 2026 and concluded with Pitch Day on June 13, 2026. Its teams went on to win the AIEC 2026 Grand Prize. The third cohort runs from September to December 2026, with Pitch Day scheduled for December 2026. Teams from the third cohort will go on to prepare for and compete in AIEC 2027.
programs_aiCamp_overview_p3: Students progress from idea to product and from pitch to competition, building the maturity they will carry into their future careers.
programs_aiCamp_team_educators_descripti: Our teaching team blends classroom expertise with hands-on engineering practice. Instructors guide students through core concepts, workshop safety, and disciplined project execution, helping them build confidence, troubleshoot effectively, and develop strong learning habits through structured feedback and coaching.
programs_aiCamp_team_mentors_description: We invite professionals from engineering, AI, and related industries to mentor, review student work, and share real-world perspectives. Through guest sessions, portfolio reviews, and community connections, students see first-hand what professional standards look like.
programs_ithacaDialogues_cta_subtitle: Reserve your place in the Fall 2026 cohort and begin building a meaningful research portfolio.
programs_ithacaDialogues_faq_items_conta: Our mentors guarantee initial introductions to domain experts. Students also develop their own outreach skills through guided cold-outreach exercises. All interviews follow consent and likeness-release protocols.
programs_ithacaDialogues_faq_items_exper: No. The research phase covers methodology, interview technique, and documentary production basics. Students learn by doing, with mentor guidance at every step.
Do students need prior interview or filmmaking experience?
programs_ithacaDialogues_faq_items_langu: All deliverables are produced in English. Interviews may be conducted in either language depending on the guest. Classroom instruction is primarily in English.
Is the program conducted in English or Chinese?
programs_ithacaDialogues_faq_items_takea: Two portfolio-ready deliverables in English: a research report suitable for university applications and an 8 to 12 minute documentary that is publicly released. Both demonstrate real-world research and communication skills.
programs_ithacaDialogues_faq_items_whatI: A research and documentary program where students investigate a major societal question through real interviews with experts in academia, industry, and policy. Each student claims one research track and contributes to a team documentary.
What is the Ithaca Dialogue program?
programs_ithacaDialogues_hero_descriptio: Connecting students with the people shaping the future. Ten weeks. Five research tracks. One documentary.
programs_ithacaDialogues_meta_descriptio: A 10-week research and documentary program where students investigate AI and Canada's future through interviews with experts in academia, industry, and policy.
programs_ithacaDialogues_produce_disclai: All interviews follow formal consent and likeness-release protocols. Guests approve the final material before publication. Screening events are open to families.
programs_ithacaDialogues_produce_documen: Interview footage, narration, and data visualization. Edited and publicly released.
programs_ithacaDialogues_produce_report_: Literature review, interview evidence, and original conclusions. Suitable for direct inclusion in a university application portfolio.
programs_ithacaDialogues_question_body: Geoffrey Hinton in Toronto. Yoshua Bengio in Montreal. Deep learning was born here. Yet commercialization, talent, and the resulting productivity gains have steadily moved south. This is the question your team will investigate and the story your documentary will tell.
programs_ithacaDialogues_question_quote: “Canada pioneered deep learning. Why hasn’t that translated into economic leadership?”
programs_ithacaDialogues_tracks_items_ca: Canada produces world-class research but struggles to scale its companies. Case studies range from Element AI to Cohere.
programs_ithacaDialogues_tracks_items_ed: Is Ontario preparing high school students for the AI era? On this question, students are the stakeholders.
programs_ithacaDialogues_tracks_items_in: Banks, hospitals, and farms still struggle to adopt AI. What is holding back productivity gains?
programs_ithacaDialogues_tracks_items_po: From $20 billion in sovereign compute to “AI for All”: do government targets deliver results?
programs_ithacaDialogues_tracks_items_ta: Why does top AI talent continue to move south? Is immigration policy a genuine advantage or an illusion?
programs_ithacaDialogues_tracks_subtitle: Each student selects one track and leads it for the semester.
programs_ithacaDialogues_whyNow_descript: On June 4, 2026, the federal government released its national AI strategy, “AI for All.” This semester's student research coincides with a national conversation on the same questions.
programs_evChallenge_competition_descrip: Organized by the University of Waterloo Faculty of Engineering, the EV Challenge is a high school electric vehicle endurance race. Teams design, build, and drive their own EVs and are evaluated on engineering quality, vehicle performance, driving strategy, and team collaboration.
programs_evChallenge_cta_subtitle: Join the Ithaca EV Team to design, build, and race an electric vehicle.
programs_evChallenge_faq_items_experienc: No. The program teaches the required skills from the ground up. Roles span engineering design, assembly, test driving, and team operations. Every team member contributes regardless of technical background.
programs_evChallenge_faq_items_schedule_: What does the schedule look like?
programs_evChallenge_faq_items_takeaway_: Beyond the EV itself, students gain project management skills, technical documentation experience, presentation skills, and practical experience negotiating sponsorships. These experiences translate directly into university application portfolios.
programs_evChallenge_faq_items_whatIsWat: An electric vehicle endurance race organized by the University of Waterloo Faculty of Engineering. High school teams design, build, and race their own EVs. The 2027 competition is scheduled for late May.
What is the Waterloo EV Challenge?
programs_evChallenge_faq_items_whoCanJoi: Students in Grades 9 through 12 in the Greater Toronto Area. We welcome anyone interested in engineering, automotive technology, or team-based projects. No prior experience is required.
Who can join the EV team?
programs_evChallenge_gains_items_busines: Fundraising, sponsorship acquisition, resource management, and the experience of building a team from scratch.
programs_evChallenge_gains_items_enginee: Design thinking, hands-on fabrication, and cross-disciplinary collaboration on a vehicle that competes on track.
programs_evChallenge_gains_items_univers: A distinctive portfolio project for applications to leading engineering and business programs across North America.
programs_evChallenge_hero_subtitle: Design and build a real electric vehicle. Run a team. Compete at the Waterloo EV Challenge.
programs_evChallenge_mission_description: Students build an electric vehicle, run a team, and race in competition. Through engineering and business training, we prepare the next generation of builders, operators, and leaders.
programs_evChallenge_mission_quote: "When you set out for Ithaca, hope the voyage is long, full of adventure, full of discovery."
programs_evChallenge_mission_title: We do more than build a car.
programs_evChallenge_model3d_business_de: Run the team as a real operation. The work covers sponsorship acquisition, budget management, logistics coordination, and the organizational skills that keep a racing team running.
programs_evChallenge_model3d_canvasAriaL: Interactive 3D wireframe of the Ithaca EV trike and program tracks
programs_evChallenge_model3d_engineering: Design, build, and test a functioning electric vehicle. The work covers CAD modelling, chassis fabrication, electrical wiring, battery systems, and iterative performance testing.
programs_evChallenge_model3d_machineDesc: A custom-built electric trike with an aluminum tube frame, designed and assembled by students.
programs_evChallenge_model3d_sectionAria: The Ithaca EV trike and program tracks
programs_evChallenge_pastSeasons_subtitl: From first welds to race day at Waterloo.
programs_evChallenge_workshopToRoles_rol: Hands-on fabrication, component integration, and systematic performance validation on the vehicle.
CAD modelling, structural analysis, and electrical systems layout for the EV chassis and powertrain.
Sponsorship outreach, budget planning, logistics coordination, and cross-functional project management.
Track testing protocols, endurance race strategy, and driver skill development under competition conditions.

academics_ap_cardDescription: University-level courses taken during high school, each ending in a standardized exam that many universities recognize.
academics_ossd_cardDescription: Ontario's secondary school diploma, earned credit by credit, and the academic record students present when applying to university.
academics_tutoring_cardDescription: Focused support in a single AP, IB, or OSSD subject for students who need to close a specific gap rather than complete a full course.
metadata_ap_description: Advanced Placement (AP): College Board university-level courses, scored 1 to 5 and widely recognized for credit. Contact us for current AP offerings.
ap_hero_description: Advanced Placement (AP) is the College Board's program of university-level courses taken in secondary school. Exams are scored from 1 to 5 and are widely recognized for credit or placement at North American universities. Our AP course list, teaching team, and fees will be published here shortly. Please contact us for current availability.
ap_hero_imageAlt: A mentor stands reading a printed handout, with students in suits seated at tables out of focus behind her
metadata_ossd_description: The Ontario Secondary School Diploma requires 30 credits, the literacy requirement, and 40 hours of community involvement. Ithaca supports OSSD students.
ossd_hero_description: The Ontario Secondary School Diploma (OSSD) requires 30 credits, the provincial literacy requirement, at least 2 online learning credits, and 40 hours of community involvement. Students who started Grade 9 in 2024 or later need 17 compulsory and 13 optional credits. Students who started earlier need 18 compulsory and 12 optional credits. Ithaca's programs complement a student's regular schooling and do not replace it. Full details will be published here shortly. Please contact us in the meantime.
ossd_hero_imageAlt: Eight students in formal suits and blazers standing arm in arm in a row, smiling at the camera
metadata_tutoring_description: One-to-one tutoring for AP, IB, and OSSD courses at Ithaca Family Academy in Ontario, focused on each student's specific needs. Contact us to discuss subjects and scheduling.

programs_investmentLab_intro_anytime: Students can join at any point. The Lab is deliberately structured in short cycles, so students do not need to wait for the start of a term.
programs_investmentLab_compliance_result: Awards, placements and other outcomes described on this site are factual records of past students. They are not a promise of any result.
programs_investmentLab_compliance_advice: Investing involves risk and may result in loss of principal. Ithaca provides teaching and training only. We do not manage money on a client's behalf, do not promise returns, do not give buy or sell recommendations on individual securities, and do not handle student funds. FIN 102 uses the family's own account and funds (accounts for minors are opened by a parent or guardian), and account opening and all trading decisions rest with the family.
metadata_investmentLab_title: AI Investment Lab | Ithaca Family Academy
metadata_investmentLab_description: A real account, finance fundamentals, and AI as a working partner: stock analysis, introductory modelling, risk management, and an investment journal. For secondary and university students.

metadata_engineeringFoundations_descript: Five hands-on courses, from machining and structures to autonomous systems, finishing with the STEM Racing global competition. The direct pathway into the EV Team.
programs_projectStudio_heroAlt: An Ithaca student presenting their own project
metadata_projectStudio_description: Incubation for a student's own project: a working startup environment and application material for secondary students, and a portfolio and an outlet for project work at the university level.

None of these organizations was involved in the production of, or endorses, the courses and services offered here.
academics_satAct_heroAlt: An Ithaca student working through a timed practice section
academics_satAct_body_1: A structured SAT/ACT course offered in two tiers, Foundation and Advanced, with full-length digital SAT practice tests on the current Bluebook™ platform.
academics_satAct_body_2: Staged diagnostics identify specific weaknesses, and error analysis explains their causes, so preparation remains targeted. Test dates are planned around each student's application timeline.
metadata_satAct_title: SAT / ACT Preparation | Ithaca Family Academy
metadata_satAct_description: Structured SAT/ACT preparation in two tiers, with full-length digital practice tests on Bluebook™, staged diagnostics, error analysis, and test dates planned around the application timeline.
academics_universitySupport_heroAlt: An Ithaca tutor working through a problem set with a university student
academics_universitySupport_body_1: The teaching system behind our AP courses, extended to the university level. We provide coursework support in mathematics, statistics, and computer science, primarily for students at the University of Toronto and the University of Waterloo.
academics_universitySupport_body_2: Instruction draws on our own materials and emphasizes method and conceptual understanding over memorized answers. Support is available as intensive preparation for midterms and finals or as ongoing support throughout the term.
metadata_universitySupport_title: University Coursework Support | Ithaca Family Academy
metadata_universitySupport_description: Coursework support in mathematics, statistics, and computer science for university students, primarily at the University of Toronto and the University of Waterloo. Proprietary materials, a method-first approach, and exam-period or term-long support.
research_hero_title: Turning Project Work into Verifiable Results
research_hero_imageAlt: Ithaca students in conversation with an industry expert
research_dialogue_body_1: Students lead the entire process: selecting the subject, conducting background research, designing the interview outline, and holding a formal, on-the-record conversation. AI tools assist in turning the interview into a research report and related published material.
research_dialogue_body_2: Through these conversations, students build industry knowledge, a professional network, and public speaking experience, and gain a distinctive story for their application essays.
research_lab_body_secondary: At the secondary level, students complete the full research cycle (literature review, research design, data analysis, and academic writing) and finish with a research paper.
research_lab_body_university: At the university level, students are matched with professors and postdoctoral mentors and join a live research project, which also serves as preparation for graduate applications.
research_lab_disclaimer: Ithaca does not guarantee publication. Where a research project meets the required standard, we can assist with submission.
research_coCreation_heading: Students Work on a Live Product
research_coCreation_body: Students can join an active product and content team. QuizR, our adaptive assessment platform, is developed by an in-house team that is open to students from Grade 10 through university.
research_coCreation_tracks: Software development · product operations · data training and analysis
research_coCreation_outcome: Students build the kind of product track record that strengthens a résumé and an application essay.
research_nextStep_studio: Developing a project of your own? Project Studio, in the Projects stage, is designed for that.
metadata_research_description: The Research stage: Ithaca Dialogue expert interviews, mentor-led Research Lab training from secondary school through university, and co-creation on QuizR.

admissions_steps_inquire_detail: Submit the inquiry form, message us on WeChat, or email info@ithacateens.com, whichever is most convenient for you.
admissions_steps_consultation_detail: A free 20 to 30 minute conversation about pathway planning, your child's development, and the program that fits best.
admissions_steps_placement_detail: An intake diagnostic to identify specific gaps, followed by a paid trial session with a teacher matched to your child's learning style.
admissions_steps_registration_detail: Confirm your child's place by completing the registration form and arranging tuition payment.
admissions_steps_onboarding_detail: Before the first session, you will receive the schedule, the required materials, and an introduction to your child's teacher or team.
results_destinations_intro: Admissions and enrolments from past cohorts. Offers received and places accepted are listed separately because they represent different outcomes.
results_destinations_note: An offer listed here indicates that the student was admitted. It does not indicate that the student enrolled. Where we have not confirmed which offer a student accepted, the admission is listed as an offer. Scholarships are shown only after verification.
